$description: Frame manifest for the DMS case study Penpot project. Each entry maps onto one Penpot page with the before / after image embeds and the annotation text rendered as a sticky note next to the frame. See ./README.md for the prose and ./scripts/bootstrap-penpot.mjs for the consumer.

pages.name: 1 · Directory Kanban
pages.annotation: Hash-tinted spine + tile keyed off data-initial=<first letter>. Footer chip row replaces text-with-icon counts. Directory and file kanbans now read as siblings.
next: OdsCardTile accent=initial that renders a monogram when no children.
Color-picker integration with --ods-accent so user-set kanban color wins over the hash bucket.

pages.name: 2 · File Kanban

frames.label: After — extension-tinted card chrome + image-preview swap-in
frames.note: No 'before' captured; OCA 18.0 baseline visible upstream at github.com/OCA/dms/tree/18.0.

pages.annotation: Per-extension tint via data-ext. Image mimetypes drop the chrome treatment via o_dms_card_tile_preview. Extension chip strips its leading dot for consistency.
next: Multi-select chip strip with bulk actions.
'Recently opened' smart filter pinned to the searchpanel.

pages.name: 3 · Form Hero

frames.label: After — hero icon + metadata pill row + path breadcrumb

pages.annotation: Answers the four questions a user asks 90% of the time: what is this, how big, what's inside, where is it. Directory hero pins --ods-accent to amber to match the kanban tile; file hero stays neutral (per-ext tint needs runtime field access).
next: Per-extension tinted file form hero via a tiny field widget that renders <OdsCardTile>.
Versioning chip when dms_version add-on is installed.

pages.name: 4 · Portal Grid
pages.annotation: Cards with tinted left stripe (per-extension for files, amber for directories), soft top-edge gradient derived from --ods-accent, hover lift identical to the backend kanban. Portal users see the same color for a PDF that internal users do.
next: Mobile portrait: stack badge above the body, tighten line-height.
Empty-state illustration with a Lucide icon at scale.

pages.name: 5 · Searchpanel

frames.label: After — monospaced section headers, tabular counters
frames.note: Visible inside every Files/Directories kanban screenshot — left column. No standalone capture; reference the directory kanban after-shot.

pages.annotation: Repeated UI furniture gets out of the way: smaller monospaced labels, tabular numerals for counts (so 1, 12, 999 align).
next: Saved-search chips persisted per user across sessions.
Hierarchy collapse-state persisted (Odoo loses it across navigation).
'Recently opened' smart filter (shared with File Kanban next item).

pages.name: 6 · Drop-zone

frames.label: After — animated marching-dashed border + bobbing cloud
frames.note: Motion-dependent; static screenshot doesn't carry the design. See dms/static/src/scss/kanban.scss → .o_dropzone.o_dms_dropzone for the keyframe definition.

pages.annotation: Motion describes the action: this is an active target. Marching dashes + bob = earned attention, not decorative.
next: Drop-on-directory-card to upload directly into the targeted directory.
File-type-aware overlay copy: 'drop 3 files (2 images, 1 PDF)'.
